notes: Launcher icon fixed everywhere, including Android 13+ themed icons: the portrait card and person now render instead of a generic handset. The green call badge stays inside the launcher mask, the handset is centred, and the card mark itself is centred. Update downloads now retry automatically on server errors and slow connections, with clearer messages. Call screens can be screenshotted again; only the pairing QR blocks screenshots. Incoming-call notification actions no longer share one green tint. No re-pair needed.
